title: Chapter 469: Sifang City
content:
Chapter 469: Sifang City

As an invited foreign aid, Wang Shuo couldn't say anything.

Because Ye Hui had no intention of handing over the command to others, and at the same time, Wang Shuo didn't know the situation of the Frost Empire's army.

Wang Shuo looked for a while and walked out of the hall on the city gate tower.

He was now wondering if there was any hope of breaking the deadlock.

The number of kings exposed under Andre and Anna was already as many as 15.

And the combat power of the high-level generals was simply impossible to count.

Wang Shuo estimated that there should be at least more than 200.

This was a desperate force.

Wang Shuo had no good solution for a while.

It would take at least two days for the enemy to blast through the defense.

The dignitaries in the city kept fleeing, and the Frost Empire did not stop them.

The end of the empire, everyone fled when disaster struck!

Wang Shuo sighed a little.

It was just a simple battle, and the whole country of the Frost Empire believed that it would definitely lose.

Before the fight to the death, they gave up completely.

Wang Shuo couldn't understand it, but he seemed to understand it.

The empire no longer had the vigor and ambition, and no one was willing to stand up and turn the tide.

Or rather, no one had the ability to turn the tide.

Wang Shuo naturally did not have the leisure to do so.

Master Tongchui found Wang Shuo, who looked a little haggard.

"Wang Shuo, the empire has no hope, you should take your people away now!"

"What about you?"

"I don't want to leave anymore." Master Tongchui's voice was a little choked.

Wang Shuo's mood was also a little heavy.

Is there anything more painful than losing?

That is the impending loss.

Wang Shuo found Ye Xueer, and took more than a hundred children entrusted to Wang Shuo by the Ye family and stepped onto the teleportation array.

At the same time, the other two Shuras also took some people away.

Before the barrier was broken, almost all the people in the empire who were qualified to escape had left.

A flash of white light, Wang Shuo also led everyone away from the Frost Empire.

Along the way, Ye Xueer seemed very silent.

Wang Shuo's caring attitude made the accompanying princes and grandchildren a little unhappy.

Their status was much more noble than Ye Xueer's, and they were direct descendants of the emperor.

Seeing Wang Shuo, they didn't even look at them. How could they stand it with their pride?

But Wang Shuo didn't care about their feelings. As a dog who lost his home, it was good enough to survive. What else did he want?

After passing through several teleportation arrays in succession, some people couldn't stand it and almost fainted.

Wang Shuo had to stop temporarily with these burdens.

This transit station was called Sifang City.

It was a small force, and the city lord was only a high-level warrior.

But this place was located in the gap between several empires and belonged to a no-man's land.

For the sake of peace between each other, several empires did not choose to annex this place.

This also led to countless vicious people wandering here.

Wang Shuo took everyone to find an inn.

"We will rest here for one night and set off early tomorrow morning."

At this time, several princes and princesses suggested going out for a walk.

They were still very interested in this kind of exotic customs.

Ye Xueer looked at the people and saw that they did not look sad for the destruction of the country, and she did not like them at all.

She immediately rejected their invitation.

Wang Shuo was naturally not interested in parading with these playboys.

After these princes and princesses left, Wang Shuo sent Ye Xueer back to the room, and then planned to go out alone to understand the local situation.

Perhaps he would have to fight with the nearby empire in the future, or not.
